items.summary: Implement (or re-implement) the dedicated Summary Delete control as a trash icon button in the top-right corner of the Summary card. When clicked, it must clear ONLY the Summary text (set summary state to an empty string) and must not modify the Quiz section/state in any way.

Wire the Summary Delete button into Dashboard state management by adding a Summary delete handler in the Dashboard page and passing it into the SummaryCard component via props, without changing the existing Quiz delete handler or QuizSection behavior.
Create a new build draft from the updated repository state and run the standard build + deployment pipeline to produce a fresh deployment.
